name: WorkflowTask
description: Represents a single workflow task in a WorkflowTasks collection.
example:
Sub DisplayWorkTask()
Dim objWorkflowTasks As WorkflowTasks
Dim objWorkflowTask As WorkflowTask
Dim cnt As Integer

Set objWorkflowTasks = Document.GetWorkflowTasks()

For cnt = 1 To objWorkflowTasks.Count
 Debug.Print objWorkflowTask(cnt).Name
Next

Set objWorkflowTask = objWorkflowTasks(1)
objWorkflowTask.Show

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the WorkflowTask object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the WorkflowTask object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Gets the ID of the Sharepoint list item. Read-only.

properties.name: ListID
properties.description: Gets the ID of the list containing the workflow task. Read-only.

properties.name: WorkflowID
properties.description: Gets the ID of the workflow associated with a workflow task. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets the name of the WorkflowTask object. Read-only.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Gets the description of a workflow task. Read-only.

properties.name: AssignedTo
properties.description: Gets the name of the person that the workflow task is assigned to. Read-only.

properties.name: CreatedBy
properties.description: Gets the name of the person that created the workflow task. Read-only.

properties.name: DueDate
properties.description: Gets the date that a workflow task is due. Read-only.

properties.name: CreatedDate
properties.description: Gets the date that a workflow task was created. Read-only.

methods.name: Show
methods.description: Displays a workflow task edit user interface for the specified WorkflowTask object.
